decision_question: Approve, revise, or defer one conditional snap-aligned ProjectRaster plus non-resampling Clip recovery envelope for the exact two-source event-area radar QA route through sanitized terminal publication?

official_method_context.claim: The Extent environment selects input cells and does not strictly clip output; output can be larger than the specified rectangle.
Snap Raster aligns output raster cell edges to its origin and cell size and can expand an output by a row or column.
Raster Clip with NO_MAINTAIN_EXTENT retains input cell alignment; MAINTAIN_EXTENT resamples pixels to force exact extent.
Project Raster honors Extent and Snap Raster environments but requires verification of its actual output geometry.

proposed_method_amendment.projection: ProjectRaster of the existing GTC gamma-linear, dB display candidate, and geometric-distortion mask rasters to a new disposable or attempt-local intermediate, using an EPSG:32645 spatial-reference-bearing Extent, the frozen snap origin, and the frozen output cell size; retain BILINEAR for continuous rasters and NEAREST for the categorical mask
proposed_method_amendment.clip: Only after the intermediate passes its resource ceiling, Clip each projected intermediate to the frozen buffered EPSG:32645 target rectangle with clipping_geometry NONE and maintain_clipping_extent NO_MAINTAIN_EXTENT; never use MAINTAIN_EXTENT because it may resample.
proposed_method_amendment.pixel_equivalence_requirement: On disposable tests, retained interior pixels and mask classes must equal the aligned projected intermediate; no new resampling or class change is permitted by Clip.
proposed_method_amendment.frozen_sar_sequence_preserved: Orbit, thermal-noise removal, beta calibration, gamma terrain flattening, the later owner-approved event-pair REFINED_LEE despeckling amendment without a filter-size argument, DEM-supplied GTC with GEOID NONE, VV/VH, source-specific orbit, masks, registration, and QA predicates remain unchanged.

hard_stops: A disposable ArcGIS result must prove the final clipped output is aligned to the frozen 10 m grid and within 100 m of each target side; a visually plausible footprint is insufficient.

Any intermediate with more than 100000000 declared cells, more than 10000 m extension on any side, or more than 10737418240 logical output bytes stops the process; missing metadata after the projection stage or a missing durable guard receipt also stops. These are resource ceilings, not scientific acceptance thresholds.
The independent supervisor must be proven to stop a synthetic runaway worker and persist terminal and cleanup evidence before any real attempt.
No source/date/order/orbit/DEM/AOI/CRS/grid/mask/registration/threshold substitution, MAINTAIN_EXTENT resampling, alternate method, second attempt, or fallback is permitted.
No real attempt starts until the packet, implementation, and execution gates pass public default-branch CI and the final no-content preflight passes.
